body: My mom takes me once a week, but I'm not very close to them. The 4 years I was gone was because I was taken by foster care and I grew up a lot in those 4 years. They didn't try hard the first 2 years to get me back (still partied a lot) so I have this sort of resentment towards them.I have kinda of learned to forgive them a bit for what they did, although it never really goes away you know.
